title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 184. Expresses deep concern that there has been allegations of corruption linked to the Commission; at the same time deplores that there has been allegations about officials from the Commission that allegedly accepted gifts from a country that the Union was negotiating an agreement with; considers it unacceptable that in this context individuals holding top-level director positions, who are subject to ongoing investigations or proceedings, are rewarded with transfers to highly paid advisory roles, as in the case of the former Director of DG MOVE;stresses the need for a clear and systematic approach to ensure that all OLAF cases involving relevant potential criminal offences are promptly referred to the EPPO and the competent national authorities; considers it unacceptable that, in the case of the report concerning allegations against the former Director of DG MOVE, neither OLAF nor the Commission forwarded the case to the EPPO, which only launched an investigation after the matter was revealed by the media; calls on the Commission to reinforce relevant rules and procedures in order to ensure that all cases are handled in a strict, correct and efficient way;
